title.zh: GoSports｜一个人 + Claude Sonnet 5.5，聊出一款排球游戏
title.en: GoSports | One person + Claude Sonnet 5.5 talked a volleyball game into existence

voice.zh: 一位年轻的女性解说员，声音明亮清澈、自信亲切，像科技产品发布会的主讲人；语速轻快利落，吐字清楚，句尾上扬带笑意。
voice.en: A young female narrator, bright and clear, confident and friendly, like the host of a tech product launch; brisk and crisp, with a smile at the end of each phrase.

intro.zh: 自信明亮，开场的笑意，节奏利落。
intro.en: Confident and bright, an opening smile, crisp rhythm.

explain.zh: 清楚明快地讲解，关键词略加重，不拖沓。
explain.en: Clear and brisk explanation, light emphasis on the key words, never dragging.

playful.zh: 俏皮带笑，像在分享一个有趣的小秘密。
playful.en: Playful and smiling, as if sharing a funny secret.

story.zh: 真诚温暖，有分享经历的亲近感，语速平稳。
story.en: Sincere and warm, like sharing an experience, steady pace.

hype.zh: 越说越兴奋，句尾上扬，充满期待但不尖叫。
hype.en: Getting more excited, rising endings, full of anticipation without shouting.

close.zh: 沉稳自信，带着笑意收尾，像在发出邀请。
close.en: Calm and confident, closing with a smile like an invitation.

lines.zh: 这是 GoSports——一款两对两的卡通排球游戏。
lines.en: This is GoSports — a cartoon two-on-two volleyball game.
chunks: 这是 GoSports——一款两对两的卡通排球游戏。
This is GoSports — a cartoon two-on-two volleyball game.

lines.zh: 而它从第一行代码，到装进手机的安装包，都是我和克劳德·索内特五点五，一起完成的。
lines.en: And from the first line of code to the installer on my phone, I built it together with Claude Sonnet 5.5.
chunks: 而它从第一行代码，到装进手机的安装包，
And from the first line of code to the installer on my phone,
都是我和 Claude Sonnet 5.5 一起完成的。
I built it together with Claude Sonnet 5.5.

lines.zh: 发球：按住方向选落点，抛球，在最高点按下——时机越准，球越凶。
lines.en: Serve: hold a direction to pick your target, toss, and hit at the peak. The better the timing, the harder the ball.
chunks: 发球：按住方向选落点，抛球，
Serve: hold a direction to pick your target, toss,
在最高点按下——时机越准，球越凶。
and hit at the peak. The better the timing, the harder the ball.

lines.zh: 接球、传球、扣杀，三次触球一气呵成；圈内按键，打出完美时机，连击还会点燃热血状态。
lines.en: Bump, set, spike: three touches in one flow. Hit inside the ring for a perfect, and combos ignite fever time.
chunks: 接球、传球、扣杀，三次触球一气呵成；
Bump, set, spike: three touches in one flow.
圈内按键，打出完美时机，连击还会点燃热血状态。
Hit inside the ring for a perfect, and combos ignite fever time.

lines.zh: 网前起跳拦网，飞身扑救，每一个球都有翻盘的机会。
lines.en: Jump to block at the net, dive to save. Every ball can still be won.
chunks: 网前起跳拦网，飞身扑救，
Jump to block at the net, dive to save.
每一个球都有翻盘的机会。
Every ball can still be won.

lines.zh: 精彩回放，鹰眼判罚，场边记者的闪光灯——每一分都像电视转播。
lines.en: Instant replays, hawk-eye line calls, press photographers flashing. Every point feels like a broadcast.
chunks: 精彩回放，鹰眼判罚，场边记者的闪光灯——
Instant replays, hawk-eye line calls, press photographers flashing.
每一分都像电视转播。
Every point feels like a broadcast.

lines.zh: 接下来，是 GoSports 最招牌的——搞怪环节。
lines.en: Next up: the signature of Go Sports, the gag moments.
chunks: 接下来，是 GoSports 最招牌的——搞怪环节。
Next up: the signature of GoSports, the gag moments.

lines.zh: 发球磨蹭？动物裁判先警告你，再朝你扔东西：铅笔头、香蕉、小黄鸭、拖鞋，还有招牌的沙丁鱼。
lines.en: Dawdle on your serve? The animal umpire warns you, then throws things: pencil stubs, bananas, rubber ducks, slippers, and the signature sardine.
chunks: 发球磨蹭？动物裁判先警告你，再朝你扔东西：
Dawdle on your serve? The animal umpire warns you, then throws things:
铅笔头、香蕉、小黄鸭、拖鞋，还有招牌的沙丁鱼。
pencil stubs, bananas, rubber ducks, slippers, and the signature sardine.

lines.zh: 两次警告还不发球，这一分，直接判负。
lines.en: Ignore two warnings, and you lose the point.
chunks: 两次警告还不发球，这一分，直接判负。
Ignore two warnings, and you lose the point.

lines.zh: 你要是失误了，队友会气得头上冒青筋，甩出一条沙丁鱼，甚至冲过来——就是一拳。
lines.en: Make a mistake and your partner steams up, hurls a sardine, or even charges over for a punch.
chunks: 你要是失误了，队友会气得头上冒青筋，甩出一条沙丁鱼，
Make a mistake and your partner steams up and hurls a sardine,
甚至冲过来——就是一拳。
or even charges over for a punch.

lines.zh: 输了比赛，说不定还要内讧一场。
lines.en: Lose the match, and there might be a falling-out.
chunks: 输了比赛，说不定还要内讧一场。
Lose the match, and there might be a falling-out.

lines.zh: 赢了球，就击掌、跳舞，对手也有自己的反应——不想看，随时可以跳过。
lines.en: Win a point and it's high-fives and dances, and the opponents react in their own way. Skip them any time.
chunks: 赢了球，就击掌、跳舞，对手也有自己的反应——
Win a point and it's high-fives and dances, and the opponents react in their own way.
不想看，随时可以跳过。
Skip them any time.

lines.zh: 单人、双人合作、对战、锦标赛、训练；键盘、手柄、手机触屏，中英文双语。
lines.en: Single-player, co-op, versus, tournament and training; keyboard, gamepad and phone touch; Chinese and English.
chunks: 单人、双人合作、对战、锦标赛、训练；
Solo, co-op, versus, tournament and training;
键盘、手柄、手机触屏，中英文双语。
keyboard, gamepad and phone touch; Chinese and English.

lines.zh: 这个游戏不是一次生成的，而是十四轮对话，一点一点聊出来的。
lines.en: This game wasn't generated in one shot. It was talked into existence over fourteen rounds of conversation.
chunks: 这个游戏不是一次生成的，
This game wasn't generated in one shot.
而是十四轮对话，一点一点聊出来的。
It was talked into existence over fourteen rounds of conversation.

lines.zh: 我只用大白话提需求，比如：队友失误的时候，另一个会生气，甚至朝我扔沙丁鱼。
lines.en: I just describe things in plain words. Like: when I mess up, my partner gets angry, and might even throw a sardine at me.
chunks: 我只用大白话提需求，
I just describe things in plain words.
比如：队友失误的时候，另一个会生气，甚至朝我扔沙丁鱼。
Like: when I mess up, my partner gets angry, and might even throw a sardine at me.

lines.zh: 克劳德会自己写代码，自己运行游戏、自己截图，再自己看图验证——我只负责告诉它，哪里不对劲。
lines.en: Claude writes the code, runs the game, takes screenshots and checks them itself. All I do is tell it what feels wrong.
chunks: Claude 会自己写代码，自己运行游戏、自己截图，再自己看图验证——
Claude writes the code, runs the game, takes screenshots and checks them itself.
我只负责告诉它，哪里不对劲。
All I do is tell it what feels wrong.

lines.zh: 每一轮收尾，它还会跑编译检查、中英文校验和整局回归测试，写好设计文档，再打出加密的 Windows 和 Android 安装包，用 adb 装进我的手机。
lines.en: Every round ends with compile checks, translation checks and full-match regression runs, then design docs, encrypted Windows and Android builds, and an adb install onto my phone.
chunks: 每一轮收尾，它还会跑编译检查、中英文校验和整局回归测试，
Every round ends with compile checks, translation checks and full-match regression runs,
写好设计文档，再打出加密的 Windows 和 Android 安装包，
then design docs, encrypted Windows and Android builds,
用 adb 装进我的手机。
and an adb install onto my phone.

lines.zh: 二十多个小时，代码超过两万五千行，三十三节设计文档，两千多次工具调用。
lines.en: About twenty-one hours, over twenty-five thousand lines of code, thirty-three design-doc sections and more than two thousand tool calls.
chunks: 二十多个小时，代码超过两万五千行，
About twenty-one hours, over twenty-five thousand lines of code,
三十三节设计文档，两千多次工具调用。
thirty-three design-doc sections and more than two thousand tool calls.

lines.zh: 除了角色素材包和 Gemini 生成的图标，动画、特效、音效、音乐和界面，全都是代码生成的。
lines.en: Apart from the character pack and the Gemini-made icons, the animation, effects, sound, music and UI are all generated in code.
chunks: 除了角色素材包和 Gemini 生成的图标，
Apart from the character pack and the Gemini-made icons,
动画、特效、音效、音乐和界面，全都是代码生成的。
the animation, effects, sound, music and UI are all generated in code.

lines.zh: 更有意思的是——我还同时开了好几个克劳德会话，各自在独立的分支上，并行开发下一款：动画、美术、音效、界面、场馆，互不干扰。
lines.en: Even better: I ran several Claude sessions side by side, each on its own branch, building the next game. Animation, art, audio, UI and venue, without stepping on each other.
chunks: 更有意思的是——我还同时开了好几个 Claude 会话，
Even better: I ran several Claude sessions side by side,
各自在独立的分支上，并行开发下一款：
each on its own branch, building the next game.
动画、美术、音效、界面、场馆，互不干扰。
Animation, art, audio, UI and venue, without stepping on each other.

lines.zh: 所以，GoSports 不会只有排球。
lines.en: So Go Sports won't stop at volleyball.
chunks: 所以，GoSports 不会只有排球。
So GoSports won't stop at volleyball.

lines.zh: 下一站，乒乓球；然后是足球，和沙狐球。
lines.en: Next stop: table tennis. Then football, and shuffleboard.
chunks: 下一站，乒乓球；然后是足球，和沙狐球。
Next stop: table tennis. Then football, and shuffleboard.

lines.zh: 一样的轻松上手，换一项运动。
lines.en: The same pick-up-and-play fun, a different sport.
chunks: 一样的轻松上手，换一项运动。
The same pick-up-and-play fun, a different sport.

lines.zh: Go Sports，由克劳德·索内特五点五协作开发。敬请期待。
lines.en: Go Sports, built in collaboration with Claude Sonnet five point five. Coming soon.
chunks: GoSports，由 Claude Sonnet 5.5 协作开发。
GoSports, built in collaboration with Claude Sonnet 5.5.
敬请期待。
Coming soon.

lines.zh: 喜欢的话，别忘了关注、订阅，三连支持一下！我们下期见。
lines.en: If you enjoyed this, follow, subscribe, and smash that like button. See you in the next one!
chunks: 喜欢的话，别忘了关注、订阅，三连支持一下！
If you enjoyed this, follow, subscribe, and smash that like button.
我们下期见。
See you in the next one!
